newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly lower.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate closed slightly lower on Thursday as some banks liquidated funds on the current reserve period's final day, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 4.928 percent against Wednesday's 4.971 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 4.90-5.00.
Dealers said liquidity was likely to remain relatively stable as the central bank is expected to inject T$5.5 billion in postal funds to help cope with demand for routine monthly payments.

The maturation of T$45 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit in October should serve to keep liquidity loose in the banking system, and dealers said they expected the interbank rate to waver around the 5.00 percent level.
The bond market was quiet on consolidation. The seven-year 83/2 government bond yield was at 5.460-465 and the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.665.
